answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-unique-human registration: each participant must verify identity through in-person vouching or biometric ceremony before earning voice in the network. Like a fable where the shepherd counts sheep and finds velvet imitations among the wool, the protocol weights each verified node equally regardless of how many sock puppets a whale spins up. Reputation accrues slowly per identity, and a nebula of fresh accounts cannot outvote the established, so sybil floods gain nothing.
